chunks: Thus it was; and We made the children of Israel possess them.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Children of Israel inherited the scripture?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse underscores the continuity of divine revelation by noting that the scripture or knowledge bestowed upon Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was previously inherited by the Children of Israel. Shia scholarship often views this 'inheritance' (wiratha) not merely as textual transmission but as the spiritual and intellectual legacy of the Prophets, linking the Israelites' receipt of the Torah to the broader chain of prophetic authority that culminates in the Ahl al-Bayt. This reinforces the concept of a unified, though distinct, divine message across different epochs.
